newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shanghai parent company in share placing.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai parent company in share placing.

text.p: The parent company of Shanghai Industrial Holdings Ltd on Friday placed 56 million existing shares of the listed firm at HK$19.50 each to international fund managers, a source from a lead manager of the placement said.

Shanghai Investment Holdings Ltd, the controlling shareholder which placed the shares, would also subscribe for 162 million new Shanghai Industrial shares in two transactions at the same price, the source from Peregrine Capital Ltd said.
After the share placement and subscriptions, Shanghai Investment's shareholding in the listed firm would stay unchanged at 65.1 percent as before the deals, he said.
The price of represented an eight percent discount to stock's Thursday close of HK$21.20. Trading in the counter was suspended on Friday.
Net proceeds from the share issues would be used for business acqusitions, he said.
